source.member: RecipeManager.TryMutate(Player, WorldObject, WorldObject, Recipe, uint, HashSet<uint>)
source.notes: Every tinkering mutation script id (MutationCache's id map) x 8 synthetic targets. in.target is a spec of in.class; in.source a GenericObject spec (its MaterialType feeds the TinkerLog); ThreadSafeRandom reseeded with in.seed. out.result the bool, out.target the target's state afterwards, out.modified the guids, out.post the next draw. Inputs from System.Random(5905).
